rule: Not done until UNFINISHED.md is cleared, the ledger entry is written, and the commit is pushed.
ai_action: Archive the plan, write the closure ledger entry, update the roadmap, commit and push.
risk_weight_note: Below the accountability band (8-10). Closure is the audit-trail control, so accountability is the right source, but the band assumes diffused ownership across a fleet. On a single-operator repo an unclosed session leaves a breadcrumb the next SessionStart surfaces, so the failure is loud and self-correcting. Weight left at the honest assessment rather than raised to clear the band.
